capabilities: Index Markdown notes into local vector chunks
Search the vault semantically from a side pane
Fuse semantic similarity with keyword matching in hybrid search
Explore related indexed chunks on a Semantic Walk canvas
Expose vault search to MCP clients such as Claude Desktop and Cursor
disambiguation: Not an AI chat or writing assistant; it only indexes and searches notes, and any generation happens in the connected MCP client.
extras: Desktop-only (macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64); downloads a managed local embedding runtime and model on first run. Freemium: license validation with a server-side grace period, falling back to free limits. Some details live in separate docs files (local-runtime.md, mcp-server.md, install-troubleshooting.md).
problem: Obsidian's core search matches keywords only, and there is no built-in way to give AI clients semantic retrieval over the vault.

relations.evidence: Built-in MCP server with one-click setup for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, opencode and Codex.
